title: Same Face Twice
description: Trying to register a second crew member under an email already on the manifest should fail loudly and leave the form exactly as it was typed — not silently clear it, and not pretend it worked.
successCondition: Registering with an email that already belongs to a seeded account (e.g. customer@swiftcargo.test) on /register renders a visible error Alert, the browser stays on /register (no navigation to /), and the email/password/role fields the user typed remain populated afterward rather than being reset to blank.
hints: The API returns 409 for a duplicate email (see docs/api/auth.md) — the UI's job is to turn that into a readable message, not a silent failure.
Check field values after the failed submit specifically — a naive implementation might reset form state on any submit attempt, success or not.
